up: Retrieve the exact activity values and chemical structures for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1741321. For each matching activity record, return the CHEMBL identifier of the compound, the canonical SMILES string, the activity type (standard_type), the activity relation (e.g., '=' or '>'), the numeric value, and the units.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741321'
